chunks: Do not be desolate at the small number of those who follow the right path, because people throng only round the table (of this world) where the duration of satiety is short and its hunger is prolonged.

key_terms.لِقِلَّةِ أَهْلِهِ: due to the scarcity of its people

ai.seo_question: What does Nahj al-Balagha say about feeling alone in following the right path?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) uses the metaphor of a banquet to illustrate that the majority of humanity is consumed by the fleeting pleasures of the dunya, which ultimately leave them with a lasting spiritual hunger. This teaching, central to Shia ethical discourse, reminds the seeker of truth that isolation on the path of haqq is a sign of distinction rather than deficiency, echoing the concept of 'qalil al-ghali' (the few who are precious).

en.sayed-ali-raza: Do not be desolate at the small number of those who follow the right path, because people throng only round the table (of this world) where the duration of satiety is short and its hunger is prolonged.
